name: rocket-on-air-sensor
description: Detect call state on the Mac and drive a remote on-air light. Four parts, one verify command.

scripts.verify: npm run version:check && npm run test:version && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:deploy && npm run test:firmware && npm run test:browser && make -C firmware test-tools && npm run docs:page:check && npm run firmware:assets:check && npm run firmware:config
scripts.test:deploy: for f in deploy/test-*.sh; do bash "$f" || exit 1; done
